column1: #   key:<prefix>   <feature>   a key whose name starts with <prefix> followed by an
#                              upper-case letter, a digit or the end goes to <feature>,
#                              before any usage routing (plan: team → team, fb → factsbook).
#   <path prefix>  <feature>   a Dart file under lib/ that reads a key is mapped to the
#                              feature of the LONGEST matching prefix. A file with no
#                              matching row fails the run (nothing lands in common silently).
# A key read from exactly one feature goes to strings_<feature>.xml; from several, to
# strings_common.xml; from none, it is reported as unused and not converted.
# Feature names are the plan's file list (06 §13.2).
